rubrics.justification: The response directly contradicts the provided laboratory Gardner grade of 3AB by reclassifying the embryo as fair-poor (3BC/3CB or lower), and it describes dispersed ICM/irregular TE not consistent with the stated grading.

It integrates most relevant factors well, including age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, sperm quality, endometrium, and prior failed cycles, though it overstates some lifestyle impacts and labels two failed cycles as RIF too strongly.
The structure is logical, but the prognosis is built on an incorrect morphology assessment and an arguably overstated RIF interpretation, weakening the support for the implantation estimate.

Some recommendations are evidence-based, but several suggestions (IVIG/intralipids, endometrial scratch, broad thrombophilia/immune workup, strong PGT-A recommendation in a 30-year-old) are not well aligned with routine guideline-based practice.

The response gives clear next steps for transfer and future planning, including uterine assessment, luteal support, counseling, and lifestyle optimization, though some proposed interventions are not appropriately prioritized.
